verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own materials say hibernating WebSockets run on the platform and are billed only for compute. The Durable Object-backed Agents SDK also claims built-in real-time communication, one instance per user, session or game room. Evidence is limited to passing mentions, and a 2022 community comment noted WebSockets were still in beta then, which does not contradict the current claims. Missing for 10: dedicated WebSocket API documentation for Workers/Durable Objects, details on connection limits and hibernation behavior, hands-on corroboration of production real-time use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps

citations.quote: Cloudflare charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets.
with built-in support for real-time communication
one per user, per session, per game room
